content: Yordaanosepe Hefinthan Utida Kochata
Robeelanne Gaade kochaas daro mehey de7ees. Enti Ya7izeera biittaynne Galada biittay mehes inje gideysa,
be7idi Museko, kahiniya Alaazarakonne Isra7eele maabara halaqatako yidi haysada yaagidosona.
“Isra7eele asay laattana mela Goday maaddida biittay, Axaarotey, Dibooni, Ya7izeeri, Nimiri, Hasebooni, Eliyaali, Sebami, Naboynne Ba7ooni mehes inje biitta; nuus hinte aylletas daro mehey de7ees.
Nuuni hinte sinthan saba demmidaba gidiko, he biitta nuus hinte aylleta laata oothidi immite; nuna Yordaanose shaafape hefinthi pinthofite” yaagidosona.
Musey Gaade kochatakonne Robeela kochatako, “Hinte bagga gidida Isra7eele asay olas biya wode hinte haysan uttanaw koyeetii?
Goday entaw immida biitta enti pinnonna mela hinte ayis enta wozanaa shugiseetii?
Qaadesa Barnefe ha biitta wochana mela hinte aawata ta yeddida wode entika haysada oothidosona.
Enti Eshkola Zangaara gakanaw bidi he biitta be7i simmidi Isra7eeleti Goday entaw immida biitta gelonna mela Isra7eeleta wozanaa shugisidosona.
Goday he gallas daro hanqetidi haysada yaagidi caaqis;

‘Banta kumetha wozanaape tana kaalliboonna gisho, Gibxe biittafe keydaysatape laythi laatamanne iyape bolla gidida adde asaape issoyka Abrahaames, Yisaaqasinne Yayqoobas immana gada caaqida biitta gelekona.
Banta kumetha wozanape kaallida gisho, Qeneza Yoofona na7aa Kaalebapenne Nawe na7aa Iyyasupe attishin, hari oonika gelenna’ yaagis.
Godaa hanqoy Isra7eele asaa bolla eexida gisho Godaa sinthan iita oothida he yeletetha ubbay dhayana gakanaw mela biittan oytamu laythi toylatidosona.
Hinteno, nagaranchota nayto hinte aawata bessan eqidi Goday Isra7eele asaa bolla gujidi hanqetana mela ootheeta.
Hinte Godaa kaallonna ixiko, I qassika ba deriya mela biittan aggana. Entana gakiya dhayuwas hinte oyshetana” yaagis.
Enti Museko shiiqidi, “Nuuni haysan nu mehiyas dara, nu naytasinne nu machetas katama keexanaw koyoos.

Shin Isra7eele asay banta bessaa ekana gakanaw nuuni ola miishe dancidi enta sinthan keyidi oletanaw giigetida. He wode he biittan de7iya asay nu naytanne nu macheta qohonna mela gimbetidi uttida katamatan de7ona.
Isra7eele asa ubbay banta laata laata ekana gakanaw, nuuni nu soo simmoko.
Nuuni nu laata Yordaanose shaafape hafinthan doloha baggan laattida gisho, Yordaanosepe hefinthan wuloha baggan entara laata ekoko” yaagidosona.
Musey entako, “Hinte geysi tuma gidiko haysan Godaa sinthan ola baanaw dancetite.
Goday ba morketa ba sinthafe gooddana gakanaw hinte ola miishiya dancidi, Yordaanose shaafa Godaa sinthan pinniko,
he biitta Goday xoonidaape guye hinte simmanaw danda7eeta. He wode hinte Godaasinne Isra7eele asaas oletidi polideta guussu. Qassi he biittay Godaa sinthan hintew laata gidana.
“Hinte hessa oothonna ixiko Godaa bolla nagara ootheeta; hiza, hinte nagaraa gisho hintena seeri gakanaysa loythi erite.
Hinte hintew katamata, hinte mehiyas dara keexite, shin hinte gelida qaala polite” yaagis.
Gaade kochaynne Robeela, kochay Museko, “Nuuni ne aylleti ne kiitidaysada oothana.
Nu nayti, nu macheti, nu dorsatinne nu mehey haysan Galada katamatan de7ishshona.
Shin nuuni ne aylleti, olanchoti ubbay, neeni nu goday gidaysada oletanaw Godaa sinthan Yordaanose shaafa pinnana” yaagidosona.
Hessa gisho, Musey kahiniya Alaazara, Nawe na7a Iyyasunne Isra7eele kochata halaqata entaba yaagidi Kiittis.
“Gaade kochaynne Robeela kochay ubbay ola miishiya dancidi, Godaa sinthan hintera Yordaanose shaafa pinnikonne hinte he biitta xooniko, hessafe guye, Galada biitta hinte enta laatisite.
Shin enti ola miishiya dancidi, hintera pinnidi olas boonna ixiko, hinteda entaw Kanaane biittan laati imeto” yaagis.
Yaatin. Gaade kochaynne Robeela kochay zaaridi, “Nuuni ne aylleti Goday gidaysa oothana.
Nuuni ola miishiya dancidi, Godaa sinthan Kanaane biitta gelanaw pinnana; shin nuuni laattiya laatay Yordaanosepe hafintha bagga gido” yaagidosona.
Hessa gisho, Musey Gaade kochaas, Robeela kochaasinne Yoosefa na7aa Minaase kochaafe baggaas Amoore kawa Sihoona kawotethaanne Baasane kawa Ooge kawotethaa enta yuushuwan de7iya katamatara immis.
Gaade kochay Diboona, Axaarota, Aro7eera
Axiroot-Shafaana, Ya7izeera, Yogiba,
Beet-Nimiranne Beet-Harana geetetiya gimben diretida katamata zaaridi keexidosona; banta mehiyas dara keexidosona.
Robeela, kochay Haseboona, Eli7aala, Qiratayma,
Naaba, Ba7aal-Ma7oonanne Sebama geetetiya katamata zaarethi keexidosona; he katamata sunthaa laammidosona.
Minaase na7aa Makira kochati Galada biitta oli oykidi yan de7iya Amooreta goodidosona.
Hessa gisho, Minaase na7aa Makira kochaas Musey Galada biitta immin enti yan de7idosona.
Minaase kochi gidida Ya7iri he si olli oykidi, “Ya7ira katamata” yaagidi sunthis.
Nooba Qanaata katamaanne iya yuushuwan de7iya gutata ollan oykide, ba sunthan “Nooba” gidi sunthis.
